description: This course provides comprehensive coverage of geospatial analysis, beginning with the foundational knowledge of gathering, displaying, and manipulating geospatial data. It includes detailed instruction on using geospatial tools and frameworks such as QGIS, R, and Python. The course delves into exploratory spatial analysis and spatial statistics, covering methods like point pattern analysis, spatial interpolation, spatial autocorrelation, and spatial regression. These techniques are examined in various business contexts, operations, and applications.
